title: Theorem A
body_md: {\em{\cite{Bieberbach-1916}}} If $f \in \mathcal{S}(\mathbb{U})$, then $|a_2|\leq 2$. Equality holds if, and only if, $f$ is a rotation of the Koebe function.

title: Bieberbach's conjecture
body_md: If $f \in\mathcal{S}(\mathbb{U})$ and is given by \eqref{eq1}, then $|a_n|\leq n$ for any integer $n\geq 2$. Equality holds if and only if $f$ is a rotation of the Koebe function.

title: Definition A
body_md: \cite[Definition 5.3.1]{Thomas-Tuneski} For $z \in \mathbb{U}$, let $\phi(z) = \sum_{n=0}^{\infty} \phi_n z^n$ and $\psi(z) = \sum_{n=0}^{\infty} \psi_n z^n$, where $\psi_n \geqslant 0$ for all $n \geqslant 0$. Then $\phi(z)$ is majorized by $\psi(z)$, written as $\phi(z) \ll \psi(z)$, if for $n \geqslant 0$, $|\phi_n| \leqslant \psi_n$.
